details.pre:
Further variables that are available:
obj - the object where button was pressed preflight_msg - the note from the preflight if provided
# sends a notification to the user notification('text', 'success | error | warning | info', sticky=False)
# sends close window action (not a function - is a static dict) window_close
# combination: notification('we did it!', 'success', sticky=False, next=window_close)
# reload and soft-reload notification('we did it!', 'success', sticky=False, next="reload") notification('we did it!', 'success', sticky=False, next="soft_reload")
# complete sample:
notification("Success", "success", next=window_close) notification(preflight_msg)

prev_instance - the previous instance, that was started prev_instance.state - could be 'running', 'pending', 'failed', 'success' prev_instance_step - name of the step that failed last obj - the current odoo object env - env object
return True return True, "Alright - doing it - but will take time" return False return False, f"Something happened at {failed_instance_step}; please check to make sure that no errors pile up"
typical: if prev_instance.state not in ['success', 'failed']: return ( False, f"Cannot start twice - please wait - the other instance is in state {prev_instance.state}" )
